item.title: Kukie Serving.09 Self-Training Rounds
item.description: How Kukie trained Qwen3.8-27B on its own filtered solutions to Kubernetes faults — why the 9B student route stopped, a first round that broke nothing but proved nothing, three weaknesses picked from an external benchmark, a second round whose collection and training both hit pre-registered stop conditions, and a single frozen measurement that judged it improved on 44 unseen external problems (+6.1%p, CI +0.8 to +12.0) before release as Kause-K8s-27B v0.2.

item.title: Kukie Serving.08 Evaluation Design
item.description: How Kukie measures a small Kubernetes-diagnosis model before training it — a kind harness that plants a fault and checks the symptom before the agent runs, a verdict based only on exact cause category and cause object, evidence v2 kept as a side metric, sets that changed role as baselines exposed shortcuts (a no-LLM baseline scoring 67.7%), four contamination paths with the one we could not block, and a pre-registered decision rule with guards, stop conditions and recorded deviations.
